reference_roles: Image 1: immutable 64x64 subject, geometry, and antique bronze palette anchor.
Image 2: accepted carry-forward glint style and placement reference only; do not copy its exact pixels.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a standalone native-alpha source layer for frame 001 of an eight-frame Hearts of Iron IV crisis seal, to be composited over the immutable 64x64 static seed.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact static subject and geometry anchor; preserve it unchanged in the final composite. Image 2 is the previously accepted upper-left glint layer and is a style and placement reference only; do not copy its pixels.
Primary request: Generate a fresh, faint warm-brass glint layer for frame 001. Place one short curved metallic reflection on the upper-left arc of the original seal's outer ring, centered near 27% of the 64x64 canvas width and 26% of its height. Keep the shape and placement close to the reference glint, but make this a new authored reflection with a tiny pale-gold center, restrained amber edge, and less brightness than a peak pulse.
Composition: exact square 64x64 target canvas; one localized reflection no wider than 14% of the canvas and no taller than 12%; all unused canvas genuinely transparent.
Background: request a real transparent background and preserve native alpha.
Constraints: the output is only a detached glint layer; no emblem pixels, no seal redraw, no new objects, and no changes to the static core.
Avoid: opaque background, checkerboard, matte, broad halo, background light, sparks, particles, lens flare, text, watermark, border, second highlight, or any change to the seed design.
